description: End-to-end smoke executed from the runnable worker images themselves: fixture generated in the validator image, validator image produced the handoff, finetuner image trained/published/reloaded from its baked-in weights. Both stages ran with --network none; the finetuner ran with --gpus all.

finetuner.weightStaging: downloaded at pinned HF revisions during image build and SHA-256 verified against the catalog (scripts/stage_weights.py); a mismatch fails the build

environment.device: cuda:0 (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU, sm_120)

limitations: Bounded fixture smoke from the worker images; not production-scale.
Image digests are the local containerd manifest-list digests; they become registry digests unchanged on push.
Training remains REEXECUTABLE: cross-entropy differs from the source-based smoke in the 7th decimal.
